【原视频简介】
Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra shipped a day apart at exactly the same price: ten dollars per million tokens in, fifty out.
I have access to neither, so I went through every head to head people posted on X in the first 24 hours and read the replies underneath them.
Astra finished a GTA-style build in 90 minutes against Fable's 2 hours, and used 28k tokens where Fable used 78k.
Then five people in five separate threads, none of them talking to each other, said the same thing about Fable: consistency.
Artificial Analysis backs it up: 61 vs 66 on intelligence, 67 vs 70 on coding agent, and Fable's cache reads are 4x cheaper at 25 cents per million.

I discuss the initial testing and impressions.More testing will reveal the strengths and weakness of these models
